This is not an easy quest. However; it is doable solo, but you will need to sneak by the outside group by the campfire. You can approach the cave from the South and get by patrols outside. They are well spaced so even if you have to kill one or two approaching the cave it won't be hard as they around level 12. Once inside the cave scope your target out before taking him as cave tunnels to the right or left of your target may get you an extra enemy or two and they are higher levels sometimes. They also respawn fairly quickly so watch behind yourself in case you have rested awhile. I was using my level 15 Mage "Pempmiride" so I used sheep and Frost Nova when I got into trouble. The stacked boxes are not hard to find. They will show as the standard gear when you mouse over them. If you are a Mage, before you start after the tools, you want to get the "Gathering Materials" quest in Stormwind at the portal and training area for Mages as you can kill two birds with one stone and get the tools and the rift gems together in the boxes.

the mine is across the road and east from Mountaineer Stormpike.  If you approach from the west side of the mine, there's a roaming guard by a picket fence.  Kill him.

There are 4-5 guards around a fire.  Ignore them.  Wait for other wandering guards to leave, then hug the hill and slide into the cave -- it is possible to bypass the guards around the fire.  There are two level 14-15 mobs just inside the cave mouth, just make sure mobs don't run away when you are killing them (they do get scared at low life).

I soloed this as a level 14 warlock.  Inside you will get one to two mobs at a time.  Look for stacks of boxes and open them to loot the "miner's gear" quest items.

Much easier to do with a buddy, but definitely can be soloed (and much more of a challenge and exciting that way)

Rewards are very nice.  If you're not competing with other groups for the boxes, this quest can be finished in 10 minutes.
